entries.2312f6bcddeac1a4: In leased corporate housing management, it has a managed-unit base of over 270,000 units, and in rental management it has over 120,000 managed units and a nationwide network built through more than 50 rental management companies joining the group. entries.4baf12d168c0009b: It has formulated a four-year medium-term management plan, “Dai-yon-ji Orinpikku Sakusen,” with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its first year. Under the theme “Becoming a company that solves the problems necessary for Japan’s major transformation,” it is promoting in an integrated manner the deepening of existing businesses, the creation of new businesses and the strategic investment that supports them, focusing on three social issues: “human resource investment,” “labor shortage,” and “seniors and inheritance.” In outsourcing, which is a BtoB area, it is expanding support for productivity improvement and enhanced welfare benefits at Japanese companies, and in the BtoC rental management and tourism businesses, it aims to become a channel for business succession by responding to regional revitalization and inbound demand.
